blocks.en: EVE University's Overview
blocks.zh: EVE University 的总览

blocks.en: The overview is one of the most essential components of EVE's user interface and is the primary means of viewing items in space. It is a customizable list of interactive entries and can assist players with virtually every activity performed in space. Preparing your Overview to fit your own personal preferences is essential to you having a successful time playing EVE Online.
blocks.zh: 总览（Overview）是 EVE 用户界面中最重要的组成部分之一，也是查看太空中各种物体的主要方式。它是一个可自定义的交互式条目列表，几乎能为你在太空中进行的每一项活动提供帮助。按照自己的偏好设置好总览，对于顺利畅玩 EVE Online 至关重要。

blocks.en: The game comes with a default overview set, which is often insufficient for most players' needs. It is often better to pick a player-built overview and build on it. Keeping the overview up to date is important as CCP is adding new ship types to it regularly. A misconfigured overview can result in the loss of a ship or worse, a diplomatic incident of friendly fire.
blocks.zh: 游戏自带一套默认总览设置，但对大多数玩家来说往往不够用。通常更好的做法是选一套玩家制作的总览，在此基础上修改。保持总览为最新版本很重要，因为 CCP 会定期往里面加入新的舰船类型。总览配置不当可能导致丢船，甚至更糟——误伤友军引发外交事件。

blocks.en: Understanding your Overview
blocks.zh: 了解你的总览

blocks.en: Tabs
blocks.zh: 标签页

blocks.en: Tabs in your overview after installing the EVE Uni Overview in-game
blocks.zh: 在游戏内安装 EVE Uni 总览后的标签页

blocks.en: The tabs in your Overview are customizable columns that you could use to filter out different entities/targets you would like to see while you are in space.
blocks.zh: 总览中的标签页是可自定义的栏目，你可以用它们筛选出在太空中想看到的各类实体/目标。

blocks.en: Content
blocks.zh: 内容

blocks.en: The main contents of your overview in-game
blocks.zh: 游戏内总览的主要内容

blocks.en: The content area of your Overview will display all currently filtered entities/targets in a list here.
blocks.zh: 总览的内容区域会以列表形式显示当前筛选出的所有实体/目标。

blocks.en: Interacting
blocks.zh: 交互

blocks.en: You can interact with objects in the overview by right-clicking them and selecting the appropriate action. Alternatively, the object can be clicked and held in order to open the radial menu.
blocks.zh: 你可以右键点击总览中的物体并选择相应操作来与其交互。也可以按住物体不放，打开环形菜单。

blocks.en: Right-click Menu
blocks.zh: 右键菜单

blocks.en: The right-click menu in-game, accessed by right-clicking a row in your Overview
blocks.zh: 游戏内的右键菜单，在总览中右键点击某一行即可打开

blocks.en: Radial Menu
blocks.zh: 环形菜单

blocks.en: The radial menu in-game, accessed by click-and-holding a row in your Overview
blocks.zh: 游戏内的环形菜单，在总览中按住某一行不放即可打开

blocks.en: Shortcuts
blocks.zh: 快捷键

blocks.en: Alternatively, in many situations, you may want to use shortcuts for faster actions; almost all actions have shortcuts. These shortcuts can be set in the "combat" section of the shortcut settings.
blocks.zh: 另外，在很多情况下你可能想用快捷键来更快地操作；几乎所有操作都有快捷键。这些快捷键可以在快捷键设置的“战斗”（combat）部分中设置。

blocks.en: Simply hold the action shortcut key down and click the object in overview or in space. Additionally, you can first select the object and then click the shortcut key.
blocks.zh: 只需按住操作快捷键，然后点击总览中或太空中的物体即可。另外，你也可以先选中物体，再按快捷键。

blocks.en: For example, to target an object, just hold CTRL and click the object you want to target or select the object in your overview and then press CTRL.
blocks.zh: 例如，要锁定一个物体，只需按住 CTRL 并点击想要锁定的物体，或者在总览中选中该物体后按 CTRL。

blocks.en: Moreover, by double-clicking an object, you will approach/align to it.
blocks.zh: 此外，双击一个物体，你就会接近/对准它。

blocks.en: Locked Status
blocks.zh: 锁定状态

blocks.en: The locked status is shown by a padlock symbol in the column that is used for sorting
blocks.zh: 锁定状态会以挂锁图标显示在用于排序的那一列中

blocks.en: While any of the shortcuts are being pressed, the overview will be frozen to prevent items from shuffling around based on the sorting order. While the overview is frozen, all new items that appear on the overview will be added at the bottom of the list and items that disappear from the grid will be shown in a faded text (refer to image above).
blocks.zh: 在按住任意快捷键期间，总览会被冻结，防止条目按照排序规则跳来跳去。总览冻结时，所有新出现在总览上的条目都会添加到列表底部，而从当前网格中消失的条目会以淡色文字显示（见上图）。

blocks.en: Filtering
blocks.zh: 筛选

blocks.en: Filters vs Bracket Filters in Overview Settings
blocks.zh: 总览设置中的筛选器与标记筛选器

blocks.en: Filters control what shows up in your Overview window. Bracket Filters control what shows up on your actual in-game screen.
blocks.zh: 筛选器控制总览窗口中显示哪些内容。标记筛选器（Bracket Filters）控制游戏画面中实际显示哪些内容。

blocks.en: EVE isn’t a very system-intensive game, and some people have computers that can easily handle the game on max settings. If your system can handle it, you can select "show all brackets" in the overview options for each tab. (Brackets are the symbols (icons) you see when in space). This will let you see friendly and hostile ship brackets on the field as well as neutrals and drones. Having all brackets turned on can help you identify an on-grid fleet mate to use as a warp-in. Many players fly with all brackets turned on, and it is recommended to do so if your system can handle it. Zooming out the camera with all brackets turned on will give you a good view of what's happening on the battlefield.
blocks.zh: EVE 对电脑配置要求不算高，有些人的电脑可以轻松在最高画质下运行游戏。如果你的电脑扛得住，可以在每个标签页的总览选项中勾选“显示所有标记”（show all brackets）。（标记就是你在太空中看到的那些符号（图标）。）这样你就能看到战场上友方和敌方舰船的标记，以及中立和无人机的标记。打开所有标记可以帮你找到同一网格内的舰队队友作为跃迁落点。许多玩家都开着全部标记飞行，如果电脑扛得住，也推荐这样做。打开所有标记后把镜头拉远，可以很好地纵观战场局势。

blocks.en: In very large fleet fights, it is recommended to have brackets turned off, as a large number of visible brackets will cause server-side lag when there are hundreds of players shooting at each other in the same system. Most nullsec corps will have instructions for their members on how to minimize lag during large encounters.
blocks.zh: 在非常大型的舰队战中，建议关闭标记，因为当同一星系内有数百名玩家互相射击时，大量可见标记会造成服务器端卡顿。大多数 00 区军团都会给成员提供在大型战斗中如何减少卡顿的说明。

blocks.en: You can press Option + Z (for Mac) or Alt + Z (for PC) to toggle all brackets.
blocks.zh: 你可以按 Option + Z（Mac）或 Alt + Z（PC）来切换所有标记的显示。

blocks.en: Alternatively, you can create a tab preset that only includes bare minimum brackets and use that as the bracket preset.
blocks.zh: 另外，你也可以创建一个只包含最少量标记的标签页预设，把它用作标记预设。

blocks.en: Tagging
blocks.zh: 标记目标（Tag）

blocks.en: Note: By default, Tags are not shown in the overview. If Tags are going to be used, it is recommended that the "Tags" column be added to the overview.
blocks.zh: 注意：默认情况下，总览中不显示标记（Tag）。如果要使用标记，建议在总览中添加“标记”（Tags）列。

blocks.en: How to add Tags. In-game, right-click the bar below your Tabs on the Overview and select 'Tags' on the pop-up.
blocks.zh: 如何添加标记列：在游戏中，右键点击总览标签页下方的栏，在弹出菜单中选择“标记”（Tags）。

blocks.en: The Tag feature allows you to assign a number or letter to individual ships or objects in space, which will be visible in the Tag column of the overview. Tagging is different from Fleet broadcasts, though they are often used for similar purposes.
blocks.zh: 标记功能可以让你给太空中的单个舰船或物体分配一个数字或字母，它会显示在总览的标记列中。标记与舰队广播不同，不过二者常用于类似的目的。

blocks.en: The tag will remain assigned to the object until it is destroyed, you dock in a station, or you enter a jump gate. This is useful for marking trigger ships during missions, marking trigger ships and kill order in wormhole sleeper sites, prioritizing PvP targets, or any other activity for which you may need to quickly identify specific objects for a fleet. Only fleet members in command positions can mark tags.
blocks.zh: 标记会一直保留在该物体上，直到它被摧毁、你停靠空间站或进入星门为止。这在很多场景下都很有用：在任务中标出触发船，在虫洞冬眠者站点中标出触发船和击杀顺序，为 PvP 目标排定优先级，或者其他任何需要让舰队快速识别特定物体的活动。只有担任指挥职位的舰队成员才能进行标记。

blocks.en: Tagging process
blocks.zh: 标记流程

blocks.en: The Tag option is only available while you are a member of a fleet and in a command role (i.e. FC, WC, or SC). If you are alone, you may simply form a fleet with yourself (your default role will be FC).
blocks.zh: 只有当你是舰队成员并担任指挥职位（即 FC、WC 或 SC）时，才能使用标记选项。如果你独自一人，可以自己组建一个只有你的舰队（你的默认职位就是 FC）。

blocks.en: To tag an object, simply right-click and select "Tag" from the context menu, and you will be given a choice of numbers or letters. Pick the number or letter you wish to use and you are done.
blocks.zh: 要标记一个物体，只需右键点击并从菜单中选择“标记”（Tag），然后会出现数字或字母供你选择。选好想用的数字或字母就完成了。

blocks.en: A faster method to tag targets is to use the "tag item as" shortcut key. Note that all "tag item as" actions do not have a key bound to them by default. These shortcuts are in the "combat" section of shortcut settings.
blocks.zh: 更快的标记方法是使用“将物体标记为”（tag item as）快捷键。注意，所有“将物体标记为”操作默认都没有绑定按键。这些快捷键位于快捷键设置的“战斗”（combat）部分。

blocks.en: Installing the EVE University Overview
blocks.zh: 安装 EVE University 总览

blocks.en: Using the default overview is generally not recommended. Instead, players should either set and manage their own overview or use a well-maintained overview pack.
blocks.zh: 一般不建议使用默认总览。玩家应当自行设置和管理总览，或者使用维护良好的总览包。

blocks.en: We have a quick-start Overview guide to help you get started easily.
blocks.zh: 我们有一份总览快速入门指南，帮你轻松上手。

blocks.en: Follow the steps below to set up the EVE Uni Overview and read on to learn more about the Overview itself.
blocks.zh: 按照下面的步骤设置 EVE Uni 总览，然后继续阅读以进一步了解总览本身。

blocks.en: Step 1 - Opening up Overview Settings
blocks.zh: 第 1 步 - 打开总览设置

blocks.en: How to access your Overview Settings while in space in-game
blocks.zh: 在游戏中身处太空时如何打开总览设置

en: It is recommended that you are flying in space to set up your Overview for the first time (Other methods of opening up this window can be found in Overview settings). If you are currently in a station, click on Undock.
Once undocked, stop your ship at a safe location near the station or elsewhere.
Click on the " ⋮ " icon on the top right of your Overview and click on Open Overview Settings (refer to image above).
zh: 建议第一次设置总览时在太空中进行（打开此窗口的其他方法可参见总览设置）。如果你当前在空间站内，请点击离站。
离站后，把船停在空间站附近或其他地方的安全位置。
点击总览右上角的“ ⋮ ”图标，然后点击“打开总览设置”（Open Overview Settings）（见上图）。

blocks.en: Step 2 - Getting the EVE Uni Overview in-game
blocks.zh: 第 2 步 - 在游戏内获取 EVE Uni 总览

blocks.en: Open channel window from the chat box
blocks.zh: 从聊天框打开频道窗口

blocks.en: Click on the " + " icon located on the top right of your chat channel window.
blocks.zh: 点击聊天频道窗口右上角的“ + ”图标。

blocks.en: Accessing the Overview (EVE Uni) channel
blocks.zh: 进入 Overview (EVE Uni) 频道

blocks.en: In the top input field, type in "Overview (EVE Uni)" and click Join.
blocks.zh: 在顶部的输入框中输入“Overview (EVE Uni)”，然后点击加入（Join）。

blocks.en: The Overview (EVE Uni) channel
blocks.zh: Overview (EVE Uni) 频道

blocks.en: You will now see the channel's Message of the Day (MOTD); follow the installation steps therein in-game and you are done!
blocks.zh: 现在你会看到该频道的每日消息（MOTD）；按照其中的安装步骤在游戏内操作即可完成！

blocks.en: Advanced settings
blocks.zh: 高级设置

blocks.en: If you want to further tweak your Overview to fit your personal preference, more details on the overview settings are found in the Overview settings article.
blocks.zh: 如果你想进一步调整总览以符合个人偏好，可以在总览设置一文中找到更多关于总览设置的详细信息。

blocks.en: Overview pack
blocks.zh: 总览包

blocks.en: Before you proceed:
blocks.zh: 在继续之前：

blocks.en: With the "Hyperion" release .yaml has replaced .xml as the format for exported Overview files. Please note that .xml imports will be supported for a limited time as per CCP ()[Verify]
blocks.zh: 自“Hyperion”版本起，导出的总览文件格式已由 .xml 改为 .yaml。请注意，根据 CCP 的说法，.xml 导入只会在有限时间内继续支持 ()[待核实]

blocks.en: Any overview pack that you choose to download & then upload to your client should undergo extensive double-checking and possible reworking. There are known issues with uploading to a different client or computer. See above.
blocks.zh: 你选择下载并导入客户端的任何总览包，都应该经过大量反复检查，必要时还要重新调整。导入到不同的客户端或电脑时存在已知问题。见上文。

blocks.en: Overview packs are pre-built sets of overview profiles and, in most cases, include their own set of settings, such as bracket display and labeling. This allows players to quickly import several overview profiles at once. There are also many other features that can be included on overview packs in comparison to your basic overview; depending on each of the overview packs currently available in public, two of the common features most overview packs promote are:
blocks.zh: 总览包是预先制作好的一套总览配置，大多数情况下还附带自己的一套设置，例如标记显示和标签方式。这让玩家可以一次性快速导入多个总览配置。与基础总览相比，总览包还可以包含许多其他功能；根据目前公开的各个总览包而定，大多数总览包主打的两个常见功能是：

en: Customizing how the overview brackets are displayed
Customizing how the overview tabs are displayed
zh: 自定义总览标记的显示方式
自定义总览标签页的显示方式

blocks.en: Bear in mind that overview packs are not official products made by CCP; they are custom-built, third-party releases.
blocks.zh: 请记住，总览包不是 CCP 的官方产品，而是第三方自制发布的。

blocks.en: There are also several other advantages of using or releasing overview packs. One aspect worth mentioning: some overview packs are designed with a number of careful considerations and standards applied. This is especially important with some corporations, big alliances, or coalitions. For instance, many of the overview packs may release "set X" profiles, which are used in important scenarios and, in turn, used by members of certain organizations; there is also the case of standardization across these profiles. While building your own overview can be good (or better in some cases), using the same overview pack across many players at once enables you to follow and issue commands or intel with the knowledge that the other person who listed or gave that intel has the same overview setup as yours.
blocks.zh: 使用或发布总览包还有其他一些好处。其中值得一提的是：有些总览包在设计时经过了许多周密的考虑并采用了统一标准。这对于一些军团、大型联盟或同盟来说尤为重要。例如，许多总览包可能会发布“X 套”配置，用于重要场景，进而被特定组织的成员使用；还有这些配置之间的标准化问题。虽然自己制作总览也不错（某些情况下甚至更好），但许多玩家同时使用同一套总览包，能让你在执行或下达指令、报告情报时心里有数：提供情报的另一方和你使用的是同样的总览设置。

blocks.en: Commonly known & used overview packs
blocks.zh: 知名常用总览包

blocks.en: Below are some of the widely known overview packs available. (Note: These overview packs are not to the EVE UNI standards and are for experienced players only)
blocks.zh: 以下是一些广为人知的总览包。（注意：这些总览包不符合 EVE UNI 的标准，仅适合有经验的玩家）

blocks.en: There is an in-game channel that ISD is referencing called Overview List as well that has all known overviews, including EVE Uni's Overview. Click the + in a chat channel to see this list.
blocks.zh: 另外还有一个 ISD 推荐的游戏内频道，名为 Overview List，里面收录了所有已知的总览，包括 EVE Uni 的总览。点击聊天频道中的 + 即可看到这个列表。

blocks.en: IMPORTANT: Objects will be missing from the overview if an overview is older than:
blocks.zh: 重要：如果总览早于以下时间，总览中就会缺少相应的物体：

en: Sept 2026: Hybrid Drones added
June 2026: The new Command Carriers added.
April 2026: the new Yacht and new Capsuleer day rats.
November 18th, 2025 : the Odysseus Exploration Command ship,
September 2024: the new mining fields, officer rats in empire, structure fighters,
June 2023: Lancer Dreadnoughts.
zh: 2026 年 9 月：新增混合无人机
2026 年 6 月：新增新的指挥航母。
2026 年 4 月：新的游艇和新的克隆飞行员日 NPC。
2025 年 11 月 18 日：奥德修斯级探索指挥舰，
2024 年 9 月：新的采矿场、帝国区的官员级 NPC、建筑铁骑舰载机，
2023 年 6 月：枪骑兵级无畏舰。

en: Iridium Overview (Up to Date September 2026 - Hybrid drones added)
Overview pack designed for every player, newbie or veteran. Useful in both fleet and solo PVP, ratting, mining, looting and exploration in all types of space.
Available in-game in the "Iridium Overview" channel.
zh: Iridium Overview（已更新至 2026 年 9 月 - 新增混合无人机）
面向所有玩家的总览包，无论新手还是老手。适用于各类空间中的舰队和单人 PVP、刷怪、采矿、捡垃圾和探索。
可在游戏内的“Iridium Overview”频道获取。

en: Signal Cartel Overview Pack (The Explorer's Overview) ( Up to Date AUG 2026 (Warpath Update))
Tailored towards exploration with limited options for PvE and PvP.
Available in-game in the "Explorer's Overview" channel.
zh: Signal Cartel Overview Pack（探索者总览）（已更新至 2026 年 8 月（Warpath 更新））
专为探索打造，PvE 和 PvP 选项有限。
可在游戏内的“Explorer's Overview”频道获取。

en: Kisover (Up to Date September 2026 - Hybrid drones added)
Created by Kismeteer in 2010, single set of tabs for all players in Null sec, maybe not appropriate for low sec.
Available in-game via the mailing list Kisover2 and in the "Kissist" channel and in Kismeteer's bio.
zh: Kisover（已更新至 2026 年 9 月 - 新增混合无人机）
由 Kismeteer 于 2010 年创建，为 00 区所有玩家提供一套统一的标签页，可能不太适合低安。
可通过游戏内邮件列表 Kisover2、“Kissist”频道以及 Kismeteer 的个人简介获取。

en: Z-S Overview (GitLab) ( In Game version Up to Date September 2026 - Hybrid drones added)

An all round Modular overview pack focused on all aspects of EVE's gameplay, allowing the use of generalized new-player friendly and/or very specific profile presets for tactical advantage. Based off of SaraShawa Overview Pack
Available in-game in "Z-S Overview" Channel and "Z-S Overview 1" Mailing List.
For best results, add additional tabs you need and call them something you remember.
zh: Z-S Overview（GitLab）（游戏内版本已更新至 2026 年 9 月 - 新增混合无人机）
一个全能型模块化总览包，覆盖 EVE 玩法的方方面面，既可以使用对新手友好的通用预设，也可以使用非常专门化的配置预设来获得战术优势。基于 SaraShawa Overview Pack 制作
可在游戏内的“Z-S Overview”频道和“Z-S Overview 1”邮件列表获取。
为获得最佳效果，可以添加你需要的额外标签页，并起一个你记得住的名字。

en: Z-S Customizer (GitHub) (Up to Date Game entities list self-update weekly)

Designed to build your OWN overview entirely from scratch, or import one and start from a template! Made by Zirio of Z-S fame, this is a way to build yourself a comprehensive overview and tweak it reliably. This permits a lot more customization and fine-tuning.
zh: Z-S Customizer（GitHub）（持续更新游戏实体列表每周自动更新）
用于完全从零开始打造你自己的总览，也可以导入现有总览或从模板起步！由 Z-S 总览的作者 Zirio 制作，可以帮你构建一套全面的总览并可靠地进行调整。它允许更多的自定义和精细调节。

blocks.en: IMPORTANT Review your Overview set-up regularly
blocks.zh: 重要 定期检查你的总览设置

blocks.en: Pilots should routinely review their overview setup to make sure it's current, especially when updates have been released. On occasion, new entities get added to the game and are placed in new overview categories and are thus invisible in all old overviews. Also, some updates and patches may bring other changes to how the Overview works.
blocks.zh: 飞行员应当定期检查自己的总览设置，确保其为最新版本，尤其是在游戏发布更新之后。有时游戏会加入新的实体，并归入新的总览分类，因此在所有旧总览中都看不到它们。另外，一些更新和补丁也可能带来总览工作方式上的其他变化。

blocks.en: Which overview am I using?
